title: First Bonk
unlockCriteria: Defeat your first enemy on Floor 1.
details: Unlock when you defeat your first enemy on Floor 1.
directorFlavor: Camera one caught it clean — a damp, uncalibrated swing that ended a life and started a career.

title: Gel Exit
unlockCriteria: Defeat your first slime.
details: Unlock when you defeat your first slime.
directorFlavor: The dungeon's most spineless combatant met your most direct argument, and neither party is recovering.

title: Rat Retirement
unlockCriteria: Defeat your first rat.
details: Unlock when you defeat your first rat.
directorFlavor: One rodent, one consequence — the facility animal-welfare policy has already been redrafted twice.

title: Three at Once
unlockCriteria: Defeat 3 enemies with one swing.
details: Unlock when you defeat 3 enemies with one swing.
directorFlavor: Editorial is already cutting the slow-motion replay. Three verified casualties from a single wide arc — that's what we call efficient television.

title: Five-Alarm Combo
unlockCriteria: Defeat 5 enemies within 4 seconds.
details: Unlock when you defeat 5 enemies within 4 seconds.
directorFlavor: Five in four seconds — the stopwatch doesn't lie. Somewhere in the editing suite, someone just booked overtime for an extended highlight reel.

title: Ten Tiny Funerals
unlockCriteria: Defeat 10 enemies within 8 seconds.
details: Unlock when you defeat 10 enemies within 8 seconds.
directorFlavor: Ten deaths in eight seconds — a timeline that required either extraordinary precision or a deeply unfortunate enemy clustering decision. The highlight reel is already seven edits deep and hasn't stabilized. Somewhere a sponsor just approved a bonus ad buy.

title: Door Camper
unlockCriteria: Defeat 5 enemies near a doorway.
details: Unlock when you defeat 5 enemies near a doorway.
directorFlavor: Five kills filed from a single threshold — the doorframe logged more incidents than the entire east wing this run.

title: Hallway Cleaner
unlockCriteria: Defeat 12 enemies in hallways on Floor 1.
details: Unlock when you defeat 12 enemies in hallways on Floor 1.
directorFlavor: Twelve hallway kills filed under corridor management. Standards and practices will complain, then greenlight a six-part docuseries.

title: Room Sweeper
unlockCriteria: Defeat 20 enemies in one room before leaving it.
details: Unlock when you defeat 20 enemies in one room before leaving it.
directorFlavor: Twenty enemies in a single room, none of them leaving before you. The dungeon's population management team has submitted an emergency requisition for replacement mobs, and it's being expedited. This kind of thoroughness is what the ratings board calls a premium viewing event.

title: No Scope-ish
unlockCriteria: Defeat an enemy at maximum weapon range.
details: Unlock when you defeat an enemy at maximum weapon range.
directorFlavor: Maximum range, minimum mercy — the camera crew had to sprint to stay in frame. Advertisers paid extra for this shot.

title: Close-Quarters TV
unlockCriteria: Defeat an enemy while within 1 foot of it.
details: Unlock when you defeat an enemy while within 1 foot of it.
directorFlavor: Personal-space violations: tolerated when the final frame is this photogenic.

title: Hazard Assist
unlockCriteria: Defeat an enemy that was recently hit by a trap.
details: Unlock when you defeat an enemy that was recently hit by a trap.
directorFlavor: The trap softened it; you closed the case. Floor-hazard collaboration is now on your résumé, which is already a better story than most contestants produce in three floors.

title: Lucky Bounce
unlockCriteria: Defeat an enemy with a ricochet hit.
details: Unlock when you defeat an enemy with a ricochet hit.
directorFlavor: You didn't aim for it — the projectile bounced off the wall, adjusted its schedule, and found a more interesting target. The ballistics team spent forty minutes trying to reproduce it in the control room. Production has declared it unscripted brilliance, which is the only kind they actually air.

title: Last Hit Hero
unlockCriteria: Defeat an enemy while below 10 HP.
details: Unlock when you defeat an enemy while below 10 HP.
directorFlavor: Nine HP or fewer, enemy still standing — every camera in the hall pivoted at once. You closed it anyway, which is either the bravest play of the run or the most reckless, and the Director is not interested in that distinction. The crowd voted overwhelmingly for 'good television' and moved on.

title: Crowd Control
unlockCriteria: Defeat 30 total enemies before the Floor 1 boss appears.
details: Unlock when you defeat 30 total enemies before the Floor 1 boss appears.
directorFlavor: Thirty down before the main act — either the dungeon is understaffed or you're dramatically overpowered. Production refuses to rule out both.

title: Mob Eviction
unlockCriteria: Defeat 60 total enemies on Floor 1.
details: Unlock when you defeat 60 total enemies on Floor 1.
directorFlavor: Sixty kills logged — the dungeon has formally reclassified your presence on Floor One as an ecological event rather than a contestant run. The replacement spawning team is working weekends. Management had a meeting about you and the notes were redacted.

title: Ratings Climbing
unlockCriteria: Defeat 100 total enemies on Floor 1.
details: Unlock when you defeat 100 total enemies on Floor 1.
directorFlavor: One hundred kills logged on Floor One — a body count that has closed out the dungeon's entire first-floor spawning budget and forced a mid-season requisition. The Floor One encounter design team held an emergency retrospective and the session notes were classified. Viewership spiked in every market segment the moment the counter ticked over ninety, which is the kind of data the network calls appointment television. The Director has already commissioned a follow-up episode with the working title 'Floor Two Isn't Ready for You Either.'

title: Cleanup Crew
unlockCriteria: Defeat the last enemy in a wave within 3 seconds.
details: Unlock when you defeat the last enemy in a wave within 3 seconds.
directorFlavor: Someone had to close the wave, and you made it a habit. Finishing within three seconds is the dungeon equivalent of a walk-off hit — the crowd will not stop talking about it.

title: Spell Slap
unlockCriteria: Defeat an enemy with a spell.
details: Unlock when you defeat an enemy with a spell.
directorFlavor: Production is delighted you found the mana bar — the special-effects budget is finally justified.

title: Melee Main
unlockCriteria: Defeat 25 enemies with melee attacks on Floor 1.
details: Unlock when you defeat 25 enemies with melee attacks on Floor 1.
directorFlavor: Twenty-five melee kills — no range, no tricks, just you and the physics of blunt objects. The weapon durability report is already being forwarded to legal.

title: Tutorial Complete-ish
unlockCriteria: Level up any skill for the first time.
details: Unlock when you level up any skill for the first time.
directorFlavor: Congratulations on reading the tooltip — six seasons have aired and you're among the first contestants to manage it on arrival.

title: Skill Issue Solved
unlockCriteria: Reach skill level 5 on any skill.
details: Unlock when you reach skill level 5 on any skill.
directorFlavor: Level five, achieved the old-fashioned way: by choosing to improve at something. The dungeon's response was to file a formal complaint with the talent committee.

title: Double Digits
unlockCriteria: Reach skill level 10 on any skill.
details: Unlock when you reach skill level 10 on any skill.
directorFlavor: Double digits on a single skill line — that's not a tourist's number, that's a deliberate architectural choice. The dungeon's balance committee flagged your progression curve in the weekly metrics report. They're calling it 'a corridor of escalating concern.'

title: Fifteen Minutes of Fame
popupText: New achievement: Fifteen Minutes of Fame!
unlockCriteria: Reach skill level 15 on any skill.
details: Unlock when you reach skill level 15 on any skill.
directorFlavor: Level fifteen — you've spent so many points in one skill tree that the other branches are starting to feel abandoned. The talent development team has issued a memorandum asking whether this is a build or a vendetta. The Director is billing the remaining five levels as a four-episode arc.

title: Cap Curious
unlockCriteria: Reach skill level 20 on any skill.
details: Unlock when you reach skill level 20 on any skill.
directorFlavor: Level twenty — the hard cap on a skill line that the dungeon's progression designers believed no one would reach in a single floor run. The talent committee's projection models placed the probability at rounding error and built the encounter scaling accordingly. When the twentieth point was allocated, the dungeon's progression system sent an alert to the balance team that has never been triggered before or since. The Director cleared the evening's broadcast schedule and aired the last four levels without commercial interruption.

title: Sword Club 5
unlockCriteria: Reach level 5 with a blade skill.
details: Unlock when you reach level 5 with a blade skill.
directorFlavor: Blade skill at five — you've graduated from 'hoping it lands' to 'planning where it lands.' The Director calls this the beginning of something unfortunate for everyone else.

title: Ranged and Dangerous
unlockCriteria: Reach level 5 with a ranged skill.
details: Unlock when you reach level 5 with a ranged skill.
directorFlavor: Ranged to five — your aim has graduated from vaguely directional to intentional. Long-distance injury is now on the table and legal has noticed.

title: Wizard Adjacent
unlockCriteria: Reach level 5 with a magic skill.
details: Unlock when you reach level 5 with a magic skill.
directorFlavor: Magic at five — close enough to wizard that the dungeon's ancient wards have started taking you slightly seriously. Spells are no longer your party trick; they're your opening argument.

title: Tank-ish
unlockCriteria: Reach level 5 with a defense skill.
details: Unlock when you reach level 5 with a defense skill.
directorFlavor: Defense to five — you've decided that getting hit repeatedly is a strategy, not an accident. The medical unit has downgraded you from 'case study' to 'baseline normal.'

title: Quality of Life
unlockCriteria: Reach level 5 with a utility skill.
details: Unlock when you reach level 5 with a utility skill.
directorFlavor: Utility to five — not the flashiest milestone, but the contestant who survives longest usually has a fully stocked belt.

title: Dual Specialist
unlockCriteria: Get two different skills to level 10 in one Floor 1 run.
details: Unlock when you get two different skills to level 10 in one Floor 1 run.
directorFlavor: Two skills at ten in a single run — the kind of focused multi-lane investment that forces the dungeon's difficulty calibration team to hold an emergency session. You didn't just specialize; you doubled down on specialization, which is a different and more threatening problem. The ratings board has already pre-approved the sequel.

title: Triple Specialist
unlockCriteria: Get three different skills to level 10 in one Floor 1 run.
details: Unlock when you get three different skills to level 10 in one Floor 1 run.
directorFlavor: Three different skill trees at ten in a single Floor One run — a progression density that the dungeon's encounter calibration system logged as a structural edge case and immediately escalated. Each tree at ten represents a credible threat vector; three of them simultaneously represents a foreign-policy problem. The dungeon management committee issued a formal review, the talent department issued a contract extension, and the difficulty team's statement began with 'in theory, this run should not be possible on Floor One' and ended without a conclusion. The Director aired the full run uncut and collected the highest single-episode ratings in two seasons.

title: Milestone Hunter
unlockCriteria: Trigger 4 skill milestones in one Floor 1 run.
details: Unlock when you trigger 4 skill milestones in one Floor 1 run.
directorFlavor: Four skill milestones in one run — each one triggers a dungeon-side notification, and by the fourth, the system was filing them alphabetically just to keep up. The progression team is documenting this run as a case study on milestone density. Production has already assigned it a subtitle: Season finale, but earlier than expected.

title: Locked In
unlockCriteria: Open abilities and assign your first bar setup.
details: Unlock when you open abilities and assign your first bar setup.
directorFlavor: You opened the ability panel, squinted at the options, and committed — a personal growth arc the audience is already invested in.

title: Button-Masher Buildcraft
unlockCriteria: Change your abilities bar 3 times in a run.
details: Unlock when you change your abilities bar 3 times in a run.
directorFlavor: Three bar reconfigurations in a single run — indecision, or methodology? The Director has ordered the production team to record both interpretations and air whichever tests higher.

title: Mana Miser
unlockCriteria: Finish a fight with full mana after casting at least once.
details: Unlock when you finish a fight with full mana after casting at least once.
directorFlavor: You burned a spell and somehow refilled the tank by fight's end. Mana efficiency this clean is either careful play or a clerical error — accounting is reviewing the logs.

title: Mana Bender
unlockCriteria: Cast 20 spells on Floor 1.
details: Unlock when you cast 20 spells on Floor 1.
directorFlavor: Twenty casts logged — the mana-expenditure report reads like a budget leak, and the arcane-regulation committee is reviewing the footage frame by frame. You didn't just dip into magic; you mainlined it until the floor's ambient energy started apologizing. The Director has marked the spell-effects rendering bill as talent-adjacent.

title: Weapon Scholar
unlockCriteria: Land hits with 3 different weapon classes in one run.
details: Unlock when you land hits with 3 different weapon classes in one run.
directorFlavor: Three weapon classes, one run, confirmed hits across all three — the armory team wants to know what you're looking for and whether they should be worried. Most contestants pick a lane and commit; you appear to be auditing the catalogue. The dungeon's combat profiling system updated your file to 'unpredictable' and locked the flag.

title: Point Investor
unlockCriteria: Spend your first stat point.
details: Unlock when you spend your first stat point.
directorFlavor: One point allocated, infinite bad decisions still available — the Director approves of your portfolio management.

title: Core Values
unlockCriteria: Invest 15 total stat points in one Floor 1 run.
details: Unlock when you invest 15 total stat points in one Floor 1 run.
directorFlavor: Fifteen stat points allocated inside a single floor — an investment pace that has the dungeon's actuarial desk revising every encounter projection upward in real time. You treated the character sheet like a construction blueprint, not a suggestion list. The difficulty calibration team is now working off your file as their new baseline.

title: Mostly Untouched
unlockCriteria: Clear one combat room without taking damage.
details: Unlock when you clear one combat room without taking damage.
directorFlavor: A full room cleared with a spotless health bar. Production debated whether to award this or classify it as an editing anomaly — you won the argument by still being alive.

title: Untouchable TV
unlockCriteria: Finish Floor 1 without taking damage.
details: Unlock when you finish Floor 1 without taking damage.
directorFlavor: Floor One completed with a damage intake of precisely zero — every attack telegraphed and avoided, every projectile read, every melee range respected. The dungeon's damage-tracking system ran a validation pass three separate times because the final report came back clean, which it is not designed to return. Every encounter on this floor exists because the design team believed sustained zero-damage runs were theoretically possible but practically implausible; this run is the footnote they will add to every future balance document. The Director has permanently renamed the post-run broadcast slot 'The Untouchable Hour' and it now airs regardless of what the rest of the schedule says.

title: One-Digit Ending
unlockCriteria: Take the stairs with under 10 HP.
details: Unlock when you take the stairs with under 10 HP.
directorFlavor: Under ten HP at the exit — a margin so thin the dungeon health-monitoring system flagged your staircase ascent as a biometric anomaly. You collected every available near-death experience this floor had on offer and converted them into a dramatic finale. The Director insists it was planned from the start; the footage disagrees.

title: Heartbeat Finale
unlockCriteria: Take the stairs with under 5 HP.
details: Unlock when you take the stairs with under 5 HP.
directorFlavor: Four HP or fewer at the staircase — a margin so small the dungeon's telemetry system categorized the stair ascent as a projected fatality event before the run data resolved. The medical team's post-run write-up contains seventeen separate entries for 'this should have ended differently' across the floor's final segment alone. Every camera in the building tracked you to the exit because the production crew has a protocol for dramatic deaths and they were certain this was it; the staircase step that didn't trigger it is still under review. The Director has framed the final HP readout and hung it in the broadcast control room as a reminder that the show is not always in charge of the ending.

title: Medical Drama
unlockCriteria: Use a heal while below 15 HP and survive.
details: Unlock when you use a heal while below 15 HP and survive.
directorFlavor: Below fifteen HP and reaching for the potion instead of the stairs — a commitment to continuing the story that the dungeon's medical staff describes as 'optimistic.' You used the heal, it worked, and the drama was sufficient to justify the edit.

title: Nervous Pace
unlockCriteria: Enter and leave a safe room in under 5 seconds.
details: Unlock when you enter and leave a safe room in under 5 seconds.
directorFlavor: You treated the designated calm zone as a revolving door — we've referred your case to the dungeon wellness coordinator.

title: Tea Break
unlockCriteria: Spend at least 45 seconds in the safe room.
details: Unlock when you spend at least 45 seconds in the safe room.
directorFlavor: You found the rest area and used it — a radical act in a dungeon built on the premise that rest is a privilege.

reward.message: Reward: nothing. You did not panic on camera.

title: Buzzer Beater
unlockCriteria: Take the stairs with less than 5 seconds left.
details: Unlock when you take the stairs with less than 5 seconds left.
directorFlavor: Less than five seconds on the clock at the staircase — a departure margin that exists in the boundary between a successful run and a floor reset, and you spent it crossing a threshold instead of being erased by one. The dungeon's exit-timeout system processes this outcome so rarely that the floor-failure sound effect had already begun loading. Three production staff in the broadcast booth stood up simultaneously and have not been asked to explain themselves. The Director replayed the final four seconds eight times before the outro and has mandated it be included in every future best-of compilation in perpetuity.

title: Just In Time™
unlockCriteria: Take the stairs with less than 15 seconds left.
details: Unlock when you take the stairs with less than 15 seconds left.
directorFlavor: Fifteen seconds on the clock, staircase underfoot — the timing department is refusing to comment on whether this was precision or panic, because both interpretations are good television. The dungeon's exit-monitoring system marked this as a high-drama departure in the run log. Legal has been asked to review whether 'Just In Time™' can be trademarked, and they're taking the request seriously.

title: Ahead of Schedule
unlockCriteria: Take the stairs with over 90 seconds left.
details: Unlock when you take the stairs with over 90 seconds left.
directorFlavor: Ninety-plus seconds on the clock at exit — you treated Floor 1 as a speed exercise and the dungeon as an obstacle with a known solution. The production schedule has been revised to account for your contempt.

title: Camera-Friendly
unlockCriteria: Avoid standing still for more than 3 seconds during combat.
details: Unlock when you avoid standing still for more than 3 seconds during combat.
directorFlavor: Not once did you gift the camera a stationary target. The cinematography team has already nominated this run for the regional dungeon-broadcast excellence awards.

title: Panic Dodge
unlockCriteria: Avoid lethal damage by dodging within 1 second of impact.
details: Unlock when you avoid lethal damage by dodging within 1 second of impact.
directorFlavor: A dodge thrown inside the one-second window before a lethal hit — a margin that existed in the data only after the slow-motion playback. The enemy landed nothing because you moved faster than the floor's collision tracking could update. Production has watched it seventeen times and is considering building an entire commercial around it.

title: Crowd Surfing
unlockCriteria: Move through 20 nearby enemies without dying.
details: Unlock when you move through 20 nearby enemies without dying.
directorFlavor: Twenty enemies at close range, and you navigated the cluster while remaining vertical — the AI pathfinding team submitted a formal protest calling it statistically unkind. Every camera in the room was on you simultaneously, and the director's commentary track runs ninety seconds longer than the actual event. The dungeon survival handbook has been updated with a full chapter.

title: Doorframe Duelist
unlockCriteria: Defeat an elite while never leaving one doorway area.
details: Unlock when you defeat an elite while never leaving one doorway area.
directorFlavor: Elite cleared without once stepping out of the doorframe — you used the geometry as a weapon and the architecture as your corner team. The dungeon's structural engineering team has reviewed the footage and added 'tactical bottleneck potential' to every future doorframe spec. Your opponent never adapted, because the problem it was designed to solve never stood still.

title: No Potion Policy
unlockCriteria: Finish Floor 1 without consuming a healing item.
details: Unlock when you finish Floor 1 without consuming a healing item.
directorFlavor: Floor One complete, healing inventory untouched — a conscious choice to let the health bar live or die on its own terms. The medical team's run logs show zero interventions, which is either discipline or stubbornness, and the Director does not distinguish between the two when the outcome is compelling footage. The potion industry's Floor One affiliate is filing a revenue complaint.

title: No Shopping Spree
unlockCriteria: Finish Floor 1 without opening inventory or equipment screens.
details: Unlock when you finish Floor 1 without opening inventory or equipment screens.
directorFlavor: Floor cleared without once opening a screen — no gear checks, no inventory audits, no second-guessing. You committed to the loadout you started with and finished the floor entirely on reflex and existing gear, which the dungeon management system has flagged as sub-optimal but cinematic. The UI team is reviewing their metrics to confirm this was voluntary.

title: Loot Vacuum
unlockCriteria: Collect 30 pickups before the Floor 1 boss fight.
details: Unlock when you collect 30 pickups before the Floor 1 boss fight.
directorFlavor: Thirty pickups pre-boss — you've hoarded with the single-mindedness of someone who read the final episode spoiler. The Director is impressed and slightly concerned.

title: Gem Hoarder
unlockCriteria: Collect 50 XP gems in one run.
details: Unlock when you collect 50 XP gems in one run.
directorFlavor: Fifty gems harvested in a single run. Whatever those enemies were worth in experience, you extracted every last unit — the efficiency auditors are calling it beautiful and invasive.

title: Gold Goblin
unlockCriteria: Collect 250 gold on Floor 1.
details: Unlock when you collect 250 gold on Floor 1.
directorFlavor: Two hundred fifty gold hoarded before leaving Floor One — the dungeon's treasury team has raised your threat classification to 'economically disruptive' and the merchant NPCs are drafting a collective position statement. You didn't fight for the sake of fighting; you made it profitable, which is a different kind of dangerous. The Director has opened a sponsorship conversation with the Floor One gold guild.

title: Broke%
unlockCriteria: Take the stairs with less than 30 gold in inventory.
details: Unlock when you take the stairs with less than 30 gold in inventory.
directorFlavor: You exited an entire dungeon floor with less coin than a vending machine snack — Finance has questions and so do we.

title: Found the Main Event
popupText: New achievement: Found the Main Event!
unlockCriteria: Enter the boss room on Floor 1.
details: Unlock when you enter the boss room on Floor 1.
directorFlavor: You walked through the big door — the one with the ominous light and the production crew doing final-act cameras.

title: Opening Statement
unlockCriteria: Land the first hit on the boss.
details: Unlock when you land the first hit on the boss.
directorFlavor: You threw the first punch at the final act. Whether the rest of the fight justifies this confidence is a matter for the next few minutes — but the opening shot belongs to you.

title: Grace Under Ratings
unlockCriteria: Survive 30 seconds in boss fight without taking damage.
details: Unlock when you survive 30 seconds in boss fight without taking damage.
directorFlavor: Thirty seconds in the boss room, untouched — the dungeon's combat designers spent six months coding that encounter, and you spent thirty seconds demonstrating that they may have miscalibrated. Every projectile missed, every telegraph was read, every threat outpaced before it resolved. The post-match damage report reads zero and the production team is calling it a season-three promotional centerpiece.

title: Fast Programming
unlockCriteria: Defeat the Floor 1 boss in under 10 seconds.
details: Unlock when you defeat the Floor 1 boss in under 10 seconds.
directorFlavor: Floor One boss defeated in under ten seconds — a kill time that the encounter design team has refused to acknowledge exists in their damage model, because the math requires a series of stacked conditions they did not intend to be simultaneously achievable. The boss phase-two transition never triggered because the health bar was already gone. Three months of encounter scripting, two months of QA testing, one cutscene, and ten seconds is all it took. The Director aired the clip without an intro, without music, and without comment — and it was the highest-rated broadcast segment of the quarter.

title: Quick Episode
unlockCriteria: Defeat the Floor 1 boss in under 30 seconds.
details: Unlock when you defeat the Floor 1 boss in under 30 seconds.
directorFlavor: The boss fight lasted under thirty seconds — an encounter designed as a multi-phase dramatic finale reduced to a blunt, rapid conclusion. The dungeon's encounter design team is reviewing the pacing logs and has requested a new difficulty tier above the current cap. The Director aired the clip at triple speed just to give it appropriate gravitas.

title: Finale at 1 HP
unlockCriteria: Defeat the Floor 1 boss while below 10 HP.
details: Unlock when you defeat the Floor 1 boss while below 10 HP.
directorFlavor: Below ten HP at the moment the boss fell — a health state the dungeon's encounter-monitoring system classifies as critical patient, active combat context. You absorbed everything the boss had to offer, declined to leave for healing, and delivered the final blow at a margin the actuarial team calls statistically insulting to the survival model. The broadcast team watched the health bar tick downward across the entire final phase and chose not to cut away because the footage was too good to interrupt. The Director promoted the editor who chose to air the kill shot in slow motion without asking for approval, because some decisions are correct regardless of process.

title: No Notes
unlockCriteria: Defeat the Floor 1 boss without taking damage.
details: Unlock when you defeat the Floor 1 boss without taking damage.
directorFlavor: Boss defeated without a single point of damage received — a clean fight against an encounter specifically designed to prevent clean fights, full stop. The boss health went to zero and the player health did not move, which is a combination the dungeon's combat systems treat as an anomaly flag requiring manual review. Every dodge was real, every pattern was read, and every window was used without wasting a frame; the fight had structure and you imposed yours on top of it without compromise. The Director issued a network-wide memo declaring the broadcast a critical artistic moment, which is unprecedented language for a combat encounter and which no one in the building disagreed with.

title: Overproduction
unlockCriteria: Deal 3x boss max HP total damage during the encounter.
details: Unlock when you deal 3x boss max HP total damage during the encounter.
directorFlavor: Three times the boss's maximum health delivered across the encounter — a damage total that suggests you weren't trying to win, you were trying to make a point. The dungeon's HP accounting system logged the overage as 'enthusiastic' and the encounter designers held a post-mortem to determine whether this was their fault. Production is calling the broadcast edit generously paced.

title: Style Bonus
unlockCriteria: Defeat the boss after triggering at least 3 abilities.
details: Unlock when you defeat the boss after triggering at least 3 abilities.
directorFlavor: Three abilities deployed before the final blow — the boss died having experienced a curated selection of your kit, like a test audience for a variety special. Each trigger was logged by the dungeon's analytics layer, which noted the fight had 'narrative structure' — an observation the encounter team found deeply unsettling. The Director awarded the Style Bonus personally.

title: Budget Boss Kill
unlockCriteria: Defeat the boss with only common gear equipped.
details: Unlock when you defeat the boss with only common gear equipped.
directorFlavor: Full common loadout, boss dead — you stripped out every rare piece and closed the final encounter on baseline stats, which is either a constraint run or a public demonstration of contempt for the gear system. The itemization team is reviewing the footage and has declined to issue a statement. The difficulty regression engineers are treating this as a data point and a personal affront.

title: Exit Strategy
unlockCriteria: Unlock the stairs objective on Floor 1.
details: Unlock when you unlock the stairs objective on Floor 1.
directorFlavor: The exit paperwork has been filed; what you do with the next three minutes is entirely your fault.

title: There It Is
unlockCriteria: Discover the stairs location.
details: Unlock when you discover the stairs location.
directorFlavor: You found the door everyone else was too dead to use — it's unlocked, it's glowing, and it's judging your pace.

title: Paperwork Enjoyer
unlockCriteria: Accept your first quest.
details: Unlock when you accept your first quest.
directorFlavor: You took the job without reading the fine print — a tradition in this dungeon stretching back to Season One.

title: Task Manager
unlockCriteria: Complete your first quest.
details: Unlock when you complete your first quest.
directorFlavor: Quest closed, objective confirmed, NPC notified. You completed a task in a dungeon specifically designed to prevent that — take the win, because the next one comes with three pages of asterisks.

title: Completionist-ish
unlockCriteria: Complete all Floor 1 quests in one run.
details: Unlock when you complete all Floor 1 quests in one run.
directorFlavor: Every Floor One quest completed in a single pass — every NPC consulted, every objective closed, every side note treated as mandatory content. The quest design team builds these as optional structures that most contestants skip entirely; you finished the full catalogue with time on the clock. The Director's notes read: cast this one again.

title: HR Approved
unlockCriteria: Discover the safe room.
details: Unlock when you discover the safe room.
directorFlavor: The one room where nothing tries to kill you — you located it, which means the dungeon just got 40% less lethal.

title: Social Build
unlockCriteria: Talk to all Floor 1 key NPCs.
details: Unlock when you talk to all Floor 1 key NPCs.
directorFlavor: Every key contact engaged, every dialogue tree exhausted. The dungeon's cast gave their lines; you collected the intelligence and exactly none of them suspect a thing.

title: Loyal Customer
unlockCriteria: Buy your first piece of gear.
details: Unlock when you buy your first piece of gear.
directorFlavor: You found the shop, had enough gold to participate, and made a transaction. The Director has commissioned a full sponsorship segment and is calling this the run's 'shopping arc.'

title: Dressed for Ratings
unlockCriteria: Equip all major gear slots once.
details: Unlock when you equip all major gear slots once.
directorFlavor: Every gear slot filled in a single run — head to boots, weapons to accessories, nothing vacant. The dungeon's equipment tracking system flagged a full-slot loadout before the boss room as statistically unusual, and the loot design team is pulling the distribution logs to understand how it happened. You arrived at the final encounter properly dressed, which the Director considers a baseline professional courtesy.

title: Roll Credits (Floor 1)
unlockCriteria: Clear Floor 1 and take the stairs alive.
details: Unlock when you clear Floor 1 and take the stairs alive.
directorFlavor: Floor One complete — you found the objective, killed what needed killing, avoided enough of what needed avoiding, and walked out vertical. The Director is already working on the next floor's casting materials.

title: Kaboom!
unlockCriteria: Step on your first trap and survive.
details: Unlock when you step on your first trap and survive.
directorFlavor: You detonated floor hardware with your body and walked away — traps are officially reclassified as 'floor texture' in your file.

title: Frequent Flyer (Traps)
unlockCriteria: Trigger 3 traps in one run and survive all of them.
details: Unlock when you trigger 3 traps in one run and survive all of them.
directorFlavor: Three traps triggered, three times survived — at this point the dungeon's hazard team is taking it personally. You've turned the floor architecture into a contact sport and somehow remained the winner.

title: Mine Sweepern't
unlockCriteria: Trigger a trap and still clear the room.
details: Unlock when you trigger a trap and still clear the room.
directorFlavor: You stepped on the trap and kept working. The floor hardware disrupted your momentum for approximately one second before you filed it under 'minor inconvenience' and finished the job.

title: Bait Technician
unlockCriteria: Lure 5 enemies through traps in one run.
details: Unlock when you lure 5 enemies through traps in one run.
directorFlavor: Five enemies redirected through active floor hazards over the course of a single run — a consistent tactical pattern that required not just trap awareness but precision placement of bait routes. The dungeon's mob-pathfinding team has submitted a request to add trap-avoidance logic to the next patch. Legal has flagged the methodology as 'weaponizing the floor against itself' and approved it anyway.

title: Geometry Major
unlockCriteria: Travel 500 feet while hugging room edges.
details: Unlock when you travel 500 feet while hugging room edges.
directorFlavor: Five hundred feet of deliberate perimeter-scraping — the cartography team is calling it performance art.

title: Zig. Zag. Win.
unlockCriteria: Make 50 direction changes during one combat encounter.
details: Unlock when you make 50 direction changes during one combat encounter.
directorFlavor: Fifty direction reversals in a single fight — the camera drones entered motion sickness protocol and the enemies eventually gave up trying to predict you. Chaos as tactics: validated.

title: No Brake Pedal
unlockCriteria: Go 60 seconds without stopping movement during combat.
details: Unlock when you go 60 seconds without stopping movement during combat.
directorFlavor: Sixty consecutive seconds of movement in active combat — no pauses, no resets, no stationary frames the dungeon's tracking system could tag as momentarily safe. The AI pathfinding layer started filing movement-prediction errors after thirty seconds and had fully deferred to chaos-tolerance protocols by fifty. The crowd's engagement metrics spiked in real time as the timer climbed, and the Director has ordered the kinetic tracking overlay locked to this clip for the floor's promotional reel.

title: Door Dancer
unlockCriteria: Cross the same doorway 10 times during one fight.
details: Unlock when you cross the same doorway 10 times during one fight.
directorFlavor: Ten doorway crossings mid-combat — the dungeon structural team is questioning the frame rating and the enemy AI is filing a kiting complaint that legal has deemed technically permissible.

title: Corner Clutch
unlockCriteria: Survive 20 seconds while boxed near a corner.
details: Unlock when you survive 20 seconds while boxed near a corner.
directorFlavor: Twenty seconds in a corner with geometry on two sides and enemies on the rest — a survival window that required either flawless play or extraordinarily poor enemy scheduling, and the footage shows it was both. The dungeon's positioning analytics flagged this as a maximum-stress geometry event and kept flagging it every three seconds until the situation resolved. Production screened this clip in the opening sequence of next season's promo and didn't explain the context.

title: Loot Under Fire
unlockCriteria: Collect 8 pickups while enemies are within melee range.
details: Unlock when you collect 8 pickups while enemies are within melee range.
directorFlavor: Eight pickups collected under active melee pressure — each one gathered while something with a weapon was attempting to express a counterargument. The loot-pickup animation is not designed for combat contexts, and the inventory team's collision notes from this run read like a complaint form. The Director awarded this segment a separate production credit.

title: XP Rush
unlockCriteria: Gain 3 levels within 60 seconds.
details: Unlock when you gain 3 levels within 60 seconds.
directorFlavor: Three levels in sixty seconds — a progression burst that triggered the dungeon's anomaly detection flag and caused the scaling system to file a live recalculation request mid-run. The encounter team checks this stat manually after every reported high-speed leveling event. You compressed an entire act of character development into a single minute, which the narrative structure team is describing as pace-breaking in the best possible way.

title: Bag Opened
unlockCriteria: Open inventory for the first time in a safe room.
details: Unlock when you open inventory for the first time in a safe room.
directorFlavor: You opened the bag — it was full of things you forgot you had, and the Director is choosing not to comment.

title: Wardrobe Change
unlockCriteria: Open equipment for the first time in a safe room.
details: Unlock when you open equipment for the first time in a safe room.
directorFlavor: Equipment screen accessed, gear reviewed, confidence acquired — actual improvement: pending audience deliberation.

title: Fashion Kill
unlockCriteria: Equip a new item and defeat an enemy within 5 seconds.
details: Unlock when you equip a new item and defeat an enemy within 5 seconds.
directorFlavor: New item equipped, enemy dead five seconds later — the unboxing-to-violence pipeline has never been tighter. Sponsorship team is calling it the most efficient product placement in dungeon history.

title: Starter Weapon Legend
unlockCriteria: Clear Floor 1 without changing your starting weapon.
details: Unlock when you clear Floor 1 without changing your starting weapon.
directorFlavor: Floor One cleared with the original starting weapon still in hand — every pickup considered, every shop browsed, and the opening piece of gear retained through all of it. The itemization team leaves the upgrade path open precisely so contestants will use it; you documented that it's optional. The dungeon's narrative director has added 'committed to the bit' to your contestant profile.

title: One-Track Mind
unlockCriteria: Clear Floor 1 while leveling only one skill tree.
details: Unlock when you clear Floor 1 while leveling only one skill tree.
directorFlavor: Every skill point funneled into a single tree from floor start to floor finish — every level-up was a confirmation of the same decision, repeated without deviation. The dungeon's progression system is designed around branching; you treated it as a straight line. The difficulty team has noted that this run pattern creates a narrow but structurally significant edge case, and they have chosen to frame it as a feature.

title: Glass Cannon TV
unlockCriteria: Clear Floor 1 with zero defense upgrades.
details: Unlock when you clear Floor 1 with zero defense upgrades.
directorFlavor: Floor One cleared with a defense investment of zero — every stat point allocated to output, nothing to mitigation, the full risk loaded into the damage side of the ledger. The dungeon's encounter-scaling team built every room on this floor with the assumption that contestants would have at least some protective stat overhead; your file does not contain any and the system had to fall back to the theoretical zero-defense edge case it was never seriously expected to use. You converted the entire floor into a math problem with only one viable solution — kill everything faster than it kills you — and you solved it with no margin for error and apparently no interest in one. The Director declared the broadcast the most kinetically honest television produced this season, and the network's legal team has asked for a content warning category that doesn't exist yet.

title: Pacifist-ish
unlockCriteria: Reach the boss room with under 20 enemy defeats.
details: Unlock when you reach the boss room with under 20 enemy defeats.
directorFlavor: Under twenty kills at the boss door — most of the dungeon's population survived your run, which is unusual enough that the mob-census department issued a positive-variance alert. You navigated most of Floor One without engaging its primary design mechanic, which the combat team is describing diplomatically as an alternative routing strategy. The Director watched the avoidance footage twice and greenlit a documentary segment called 'The Other Side of the Fight.'

reward.message: Reward: nothing. Minimal violence, maximum suspense.

title: Showboater
unlockCriteria: Trigger 5 different achievement categories in one run.
details: Unlock when you trigger 5 different achievement categories in one run.
directorFlavor: Five distinct achievement categories activated in a single run — a breadth of chaos that required not just combat competence but accidental or deliberate disruption across multiple game systems simultaneously. The achievement tracking layer logged each trigger separately and then generated a composite alert the engineering team had never seen before. Production is calling this run 'the sampler platter' and the Director has already scheduled it for the best-of compilation.

title: Floor 1 Grand Tour
unlockCriteria: Unlock 25 different achievements in a single Floor 1 run.
details: Unlock when you unlock 25 different achievements in a single Floor 1 run.
directorFlavor: Twenty-five distinct achievements unlocked across every system in a single Floor One run — a coverage density that forced the achievement-tracking layer into a processing queue designed to handle the full season, not a single run. Every mechanic touched, every category triggered, every tracking condition satisfied within one continuous session; the dungeon's analytics team has already begun building a retroactive map of exactly how this was structured because it defies the probability model. The run log is being used in the achievement design review meeting as primary evidence for why the Grand Tour milestone needed a dedicated title. The Director ordered the full run aired in an unbroken broadcast, described it in the press release as a singular event in the history of the program, and quietly raised the renewal budget for the following season before the final credits rolled.
